description: Delete one managed asset from the open site's asset gallery. By default this refuses assets referenced by any page, shared symbol, style, or site setting; call swebsy_list_assets first. force:true also clears live component references and should be used only when that is explicitly intended.

assetId.description: Managed asset ID returned by swebsy_list_assets.

force.description: Allow deleting an in-use asset and clearing its live references. Default false.

name: swebsy_delete_asset
